reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Topic: Indiana (2021) - meaning/use of the term "order of possession"
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (question facts)
   ========================= */

% The question is about Indiana law in 2021.
scenario_state(indiana).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The term at issue and the proposed meaning from the question.
scenario_term(order_of_possession).
scenario_proposed_meaning(court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded scenario is present.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(indiana),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_term(order_of_possession),
    scenario_proposed_meaning(court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).


/* =========================
   Statute translations
   ========================= */

% --- IN Code  32-30-3-7 (2021) ---
% "The court shall direct the order of possession to the sheriff or other officer
%  charged with executing the order ..."

statute_32_30_3_7_order_directed_to_executing_officer(indiana, 2021).

% The statute identifies who the "authorities" are (sheriff or other executing officer).
statute_32_30_3_7_executing_authority(indiana, 2021, sheriff).
statute_32_30_3_7_executing_authority(indiana, 2021, other_officer_charged_with_executing_order).

% "The order of possession must ... direct the executing officer to ...
%  ... put the plaintiff in possession of the property by removing the defendant
%  and the defendant's personal property ..."
% (This is conditional in the statute on lack of a written undertaking, but it still
%  establishes that an order of possession is an order to an officer that can require removal.)
statute_32_30_3_7_order_can_require_removal_of_defendant(indiana, 2021).

% --- IN Code  32-30-8-12 (2021) ---
% "(b) ... the court shall require the sheriff to execute the order of possession
%  not later than five (5) days after the order is issued."
statute_32_30_8_12_court_requires_sheriff_execute_order(indiana, 2021).
statute_32_30_8_12_execution_deadline_days(indiana, 2021, 5).

% --- IN Code  34-55-1-3 (2021) ---
% "There are three (3) kinds of executions: ... (3) Execution for the delivery of the
%  possession of real or personal property ..."
statute_34_55_1_3_execution_kind_delivery_of_possession(indiana, 2021).


/* =========================
   Legal reasoning helpers
   ========================= */

% "Authorities" for this context = sheriff or other officer charged with executing the order.
legal_authority(indiana, 2021, Authority) :-
    statute_32_30_3_7_executing_authority(indiana, 2021, Authority).

% An "order of possession" (as used in these statutes) is a court order directed to authorities
% (sheriff/other executing officer) that may require removing the defendant/tenant to put the
% plaintiff/owner in possession.
legal_term_order_of_possession_means_court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_defendant(indiana, 2021) :-
    statute_32_30_3_7_order_directed_to_executing_officer(indiana, 2021),
    legal_authority(indiana, 2021, _SomeAuthority),
    statute_32_30_3_7_order_can_require_removal_of_defendant(indiana, 2021),
    statute_32_30_8_12_court_requires_sheriff_execute_order(indiana, 2021),
    statute_34_55_1_3_execution_kind_delivery_of_possession(indiana, 2021).

% Map the scenario's proposed meaning to the statute-derived meaning.
legal_supports_proposed_meaning(indiana, 2021, court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant) :-
    % The statutes speak in terms of removing the "defendant"; in eviction/possession context,
    % that corresponds to removing the tenant/occupant.
    legal_term_order_of_possession_means_court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_defendant(indiana, 2021).


/* =========================
   Answer
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_proposed_meaning(Meaning),
    legal_supports_proposed_meaning(State, Year, Meaning),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.


/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the term 'Order of possession' used to refer to the order from the court to the authorities to remove a tenant?
